summary: The repository defines a Go backend that accepts versioned validation contracts through POST /api/v1/validate, filters and orders stages, dispatches them to configured validator services, evaluates two local cross-stage link kinds, and returns normalized stage/link reports. It has no visible migrations or CI configuration and documents explicit compatibility limits for legacy execution and several runtime-heavy engines.

facts.name: orchestrate_validation
facts.value: Parse, filter, order, execute stages, then evaluate links
facts.explanation: Execution parses the contract, filters stages by mode, and orders them before running validation.

facts.name: failed_stage_dependency

facts.name: final_only_engines

facts.name: known_stage_dependency
facts.value: Stage dependencies must reference known stage ids
facts.explanation: Every stage dependency must resolve to another included stage.

facts.name: legacy_contract_fallback

facts.name: legacy_execution_unavailable

facts.name: required_link_failure
facts.value: A failed non-optional link fails the result
facts.explanation: Only failure of a non-optional link directly makes the overall result fail.

facts.name: required_stage_failure

facts.explanation: Only failure of a non-optional stage directly makes the overall result fail.

facts.name: stage_identity_required
facts.value: Every stage requires an id and engine
facts.explanation: Each stage must identify itself and its engine.

facts.name: unique_stage_id
facts.explanation: Duplicate stage identifiers make the contract invalid.
